'''Geeda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] merchant who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop down in the [[Old Galactic Market]]'s Concourse Bazaar where he sold [[Synthleather/Legends|synthleather]] jackets.

==Behind the scenes==
Geeda appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an armor vendor in Coruscant's Old Galactic Market Concourse Bazaar.
